title: I spent $266 and four AI models to own my tablet. GLM-5.3 finished it in a day
summary: The author details using four AI models, including GLM-5.3, to gain full ownership of an Amazon Fire HD tablet, spending $266. The process involved jailbreaking and customizing the device, with GLM-5.3 completing the task in a day, showcasing practical AI-assisted hardware hacking.
